title: Потасовка с Нагиевым  (The Scuffle with Nagiyev)

segments.t: When Vasily smart-mouths Nagiyev and splashes water onto his expensive suit, a furious Nagiyev grabs the young man by the collar to throw him out. Chef Barinov and Elena Pavlovna rush over in horror as Elena cries out that the boy is her son.
